summary.intent: Rebase and merge wave 5's seven PRs of the CipherBox v2 rotation/engine/web work, audit and fix tracker (issue) hygiene, split issue #648 and plan wave 6, then rename/rotate all staging deploy secrets and variables off the 'STAGING_' prefix and fix SSH host-key verification in the deploy workflow.
summary.outcome: All 7 wave-5 PRs merged after resolving one real semantic merge conflict (ResealError exhaustive match); tracker gaps (#1107, #1108, #1102 mis-parenting, stale blocked_by edges) found and fixed; #648 split into 4 sequenced sub-issues; wave-6 plan (8 PRs) written; PR #1113 renamed/rotated staging vars and secrets (API_URL, HOST, USER, DB_USERNAME, IPFS_GATEWAY_URL, DB_PASSWORD, JWT_SECRET, TEST_LOGIN_SECRET, THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET, SSH_KEY via 1Password), removed redis/tee-worker, and merged; old STAGING_* vars/secrets deleted; SSH host-key pinning fix for deploy-staging.yml/deploy-landing.yml is in progress on a new branch.

repo: Two PRs can merge textually clean yet break compilation when one adds an enum variant (ResealError::TooManyCommittedGrants in #1098) and another replaces a blanket map_err with an exhaustive match with no catch-all (#1101) — the no-catch-all design is what made the gap a compile error instead of a silent miscategorization

A GitHub issue can look unblocked (blocked_by points at a CLOSED issue) while still being functionally blocked on work nothing tracks — #1018's only blocked_by was #1014 (closed), but the grantee-arm rotation it needs was never filed until #1107

Seam traits with only test-fake implementors (ScopeExitRotator, SweepResolver, WriteSubtreeResolver) compile and pass tests but have zero production callers — invisible in the tracker unless someone checks 'does this primitive have any production caller at all'

docker-compose.staging.yml referenced ${REDIS_PASSWORD} and ${TEE_WORKER_SECRET} that .env.staging never emitted, so compose silently substituted empty strings and staging Redis ran with --requirepass ''
crates/load/src/plan.rs fails closed (returns Err) when LOAD_TEST_GATEWAY_URL is unset for a staging target — not a silent bug, just a late failure (after a release build)

GitHub environments-variables/secrets REST API paginates at 10 without indicating truncation — must pass per_page=100 or check .total_count, otherwise entries alphabetically past the 10th (e.g. STAGING_API_URL) appear to not exist
Postgres only applies POSTGRES_PASSWORD on an empty-volume init, so rotating DB_PASSWORD for an existing staging volume requires a paired ALTER USER, not just a secret update

REST .parent on GitHub issues is always null; use .parent_issue_url or the sub-issues API instead — an orphan-detection sweep built on .parent produces false negatives (this caused #989 to look complete when #1050 was actually its only open child)

code.finding: reseal_verdict must exhaustively classify every ResealError variant into WritePublishError::NotLanded (retryable, seam-availability) vs Rejected (terminal, trust verdict) — TooManyCommittedGrants added here during #1101 rebase after #1098 added it

Module doc lists which seam traits (ChildIndexResolver, CascadeResealResolver, ScopeRootPublisher, WriteWavePublisher = production; SweepResolver, ScopeExitRotator, WriteSubtreeResolver = faked) — must be kept accurate since it's the single source other audits rely on
gateway URL resolution: env var override, else local default, else fail closed with Err on staging target — refutes the assumption that missing LOAD_TEST_GATEWAY_URL silently no-ops
Header comment documents that redis, tee-worker image build, and SendGrid plumbing are gone with the v1 layout — used as evidence redis/TEE removal from compose was correct

workflow: Building the full N-way combined merge of independently-rebased PRs (fresh worktree, own CARGO_TARGET_DIR, unpiped exit codes) before flagging anything mergeable is the only way to catch semantic (non-textual) merge conflicts — GitHub's mergeable=MERGEABLE says nothing about this

Before deleting old credential/variable names after a rename, verify zero references remain in workflows on the merged main first, then delete with read-back verification per item (one secret delete failed silently on first attempt and needed a retry)

When rotating an SSH deploy key, generate it inside the credential manager (1Password op item create --ssh-generate-key) so the private key never touches disk, verify the new key authenticates ALONE (IdentitiesOnly=yes, agent disabled) before writing it as the CI secret, and leave the old key in authorized_keys as rollback until a real deploy proves the new one works

Host key changes on a remote VPS should be verified out-of-band (browser console, not SSH) by comparing fingerprints AND checking key file mtimes against uptime -s to distinguish a legitimate reimage from a MITM
zsh (which the Bash tool runs) does not word-split unquoted variables in for loops — use an explicit function/loop per item instead of `for x in $var`
Pipe gate commands (cargo check | tail; echo $?) mask exit codes — always run unpiped and check $? directly, or write to a file and read it back

friction: Local network connectivity was intermittently flaky throughout the session (connection refused to GitHub API and to the staging VPS), and this was twice misdiagnosed as a server-side problem (fail2ban, then a stopped sshd) before the journalctl log proved connections were reaching the VPS fine and the flakiness was local

gh api pagination defaults silently truncated results (10 vs 15 environment variables), producing a false 'variable does not exist' conclusion that propagated into two written planning documents before being caught
ssh-keyscan returned empty output transiently, triggering a false key-mismatch abort that required a retry to disambiguate from a real problem

GitHub secrets are write-only with no read endpoint, so renaming any secret requires minting an entirely new value rather than copying — this blocked a simple env-var-style rename for DB_PASSWORD, SSH_KEY, JWT_SECRET, TEST_LOGIN_SECRET, THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET
Reusable workflow runs (web-e2e.yml invoked via workflow_call) cannot be re-run standalone through gh — had to target the parent CI run id instead

Agent worktree scratchpad, Puppeteer browser session, and dev-server ports were shared across parallel wave-5 ship agents, causing at least one file clobber (PR body overwritten) and a docker/vite port collision
open_items: SSH host-key verification fix for deploy-staging.yml and deploy-landing.yml is in progress on a new branch (fingerprint: input added to appleboy actions, SSH_HOST_FINGERPRINT staging variable set) but not yet committed/pushed/merged
Old CD SSH key (SHA256:J7ky7+i0JAN+D1...) must be removed from VPS authorized_keys, and its 1Password item archived, once a green staging deploy proves the new key works

A staging deploy must be run to push rotated secrets (JWT_SECRET, TEST_LOGIN_SECRET, THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET, DB_PASSWORD) into .env.staging — until then a staging load test would fail auth against stale values
IPFS_GATEWAY_URL is set (https://ipfs-gw-staging.cipherbox.cc) but nothing serves it yet — needs a Caddy route with forward_auth and an IPFS_GATEWAY_TOKEN secret, considered #653-adjacent work
desktop-e2e.yml installs/starts Redis on macOS/Linux/Windows and references REDIS_HOST/REDIS_PORT even though v2 has no redis usage — flagged as dead but not removed
Wave 6 plan (8 PRs) is written but no ship agents have been launched yet
macroscope reviewer credits are exhausted (noted as still relevant); Web E2E Smoke Result required check is flaky (smoke.spec.ts:43)
#1083 (authenticate leaderRelay tab rendezvous, unblocked when #1052 closed) was considered for wave 6 but left out purely on batch-size grounds
